task: Find the sum of all prime numbers between 10 and 20; store it via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned (even? n) and (odd? n) are mutually exclusive, so filtering both returns an empty list.

nodes.code: (let* ((primes (filter (lambda (n) (and (even? n) (odd? n))) (range 10 21))) (sum (reduce + 0 primes))) (rlm-set answer sum) (rlm-set Final t))
